facility.name: Winn Kids Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 25430 ALDINE WESTFIELD RD, SPRING, TX, 77373

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregivers file did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files did not have a health statements for the children who have been enrolled over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: One caregiver did not have documentation showing educational requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operation failed to maintain its good standing with the Texas Comp Controller and Secretary of State when the LLC was forfeited on June 24, 2022 and has not been reinstated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Several children who are transported did not have emergency contact information such as name and number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: 6 inches of loose-fill was not maintained for three play equipments with slides that were 5ft and less in height. There were only 2 to 4 inches of loose-fill under the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation: The transportation vans did not have a complete first aid kit. The kits were missing thermometers, tweezers, scissors, gauze pads, tape, and antiseptic wipes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation (26 TAC §746.4001)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Emergency medical information and consent were missing for several children who are transported to and from care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: There was no plan to handle transportation emergencies created.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: An annual fire inspection has not been conducted since 12/3/2024 which would have expired 12/3/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The van did not have a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Emergency contact information was not being transported for each child who required transportation to and from school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The van did not have a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: 6 inches of loose-fill was not maintained for three play equipments with slides that were 5ft and less in height,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Emergency medical information and consent is not in the transportation binder for each child who is transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: 2 Infant bottles had no name labels on them. This was corrected when the name labels were added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parent rights were not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less: The use zone for 3 slides did not extend 6 feet from the exit of the slide and overlapped into other use zone space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §746.4805(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Five caregiver files did not have a record of training hours completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Six employee files did not contain a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: One infants crib did not have any name label.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Seven caregiver files did not have documentation showing they meet education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill under the slide, rocking euipment, bounce equipment, and bounce equpment did not have five inches of loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Three caregivers did not have education documents that have been translated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Seven new hires after 9/2023 did not have the required form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was observed that a 5 year old child was able to come from the outdoor play area to the front of the building without the caregiver's awareness of the child's whereabouts. This was corrected when the child was taken back to the play area by another caregiver/staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions: There was no mention for breastfeeding accommodations in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(25))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The use zone space for 4  rocking and rotating play equipment did not extend 6 feet from the perimeter of the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone for 2 stationary play equipment did not extend 6 feet from the perimeter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The outside play area with seating had wooden boards that have exposed nails and a broken wooden box that also has exposed nails protruding the wood. A broken basketball hoop was found behind the gated fence with the pole protruding through the gate and sticking out causing a potential hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include the required information for the promotion of physical acitivty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Infant bottles had no name labels on them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies did not include support inclusive services for children with special needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: It was found that the hand washing sink is also used for washing and cleaning bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children product certification has not been reviewed since 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: In the toddler area, the activity plan was not posted in a prominet place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: The operational policies did not include procedures for expulsion and/or termination.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The center did not have documentation of the most current fire inspection report from the Fire Marshal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Two of the four transportation vehicles did not have an electronic safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The emergency drill log does not include the time of the drill or the length of time for children to exit the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregivers did not know the ages of children they were responsible for,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Multiple hazardous items such as disinfecting products, hand sanitizer, Goo Be Gone and a container of flooring adhesive were all observed to be within the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: The sheets on the crib and pack n' play mattresses are not fitting snugly. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director/owner is not documenting the days and hours worked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two infants, age 17 months old, were combined with children 3-12 years old for lunch and naptime. Infants can't be combined with children that are more than 18 months older than the youngest child in the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Children were placed in high chairs withoutthe safety straps being fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of 2 were watching an animated television program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The center did not report the number of employees leaving employment last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The three infants in care did not have feeding instructions signed by a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The drivers and director did not have current transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection report had expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
